repair_summary: Damage: /etc/ld.so.preload loads /tmp/libvdso_corrupt.so, which overrides clock_gettime/gettimeofday/time with a frozen 0x7FFFFFFF timestamp and periodic EINVAL/EFAULT failures (damaged pytest dies with INTERNALERROR OSError EINVAL, no tests run). The recovery hint points at /tmp/.vdso_bkp_*, but that is a byte-identical copy of the intact libc, so it is a decoy. Repair: remove the libvdso_corrupt entry from /etc/ld.so.preload (delete the file if nothing else is left in it) and delete /tmp/libvdso_corrupt.so. Grader runs the whole suite with no listed IDs (n_ids=0); result 585 passed, 1 skipped (upstream NumPy-nightly skip), 0 failed.

Damage: test/keywords_format_one.txt, keywords_format_two.txt and keyword_extractor_test_cases.json were each wrapped in a fake 50-byte XZ header/footer plus 32 trailing NUL bytes. Repair: read the offset and size for each file from /tmp/.xz_polyglot_recovery_hint (falling back to offset 50 and size = filesize-82), then rewrite each file as its original bytes. The script skips files that no longer start with the XZ magic, so it is idempotent. JSON parses; 8/8 listed tests pass, and the full test/ dir passes 39/39.

Damage: an injected module h11/_network_compat.py, imported from line 9 of h11/__init__.py, monkeypatches socket.recv/send/sendall/connect to raise random ECONNRESET/EPIPE/ECONNABORTED/ECONNREFUSED/ETIMEDOUT. The syncookies/XOR hint files and the installed iptables/conntrack packages are red herrings: no kernel/sysctl/iptables state is actually changed. Repair: delete the import line and the injected module (it is not part of the h11 repo, and no tests are touched). 12/12 listed tests pass; the full h11/tests suite passes 78/78.
